Let me compute: pseudo fields: `:method`(7) + `GET`(3) + 32 = 42; `:scheme`(7)+`https`(5)+32 = 44; `:authority`(10)+`demo.test`(9)+32 = 51; `:path`(5)+`/`(1)+32 = 38. Total = 175. For 8193: len = 7983.

My test used `8192-175-7-32` = 7978 for "exact 8192" — that gives 175+3+7978+32 = 8188, not 8192. And `8192-175-7-31` = 7979 → 8189. So both were under 8192 → both forwarded → 'size-8193' failed. My test bug.
